summary: Phase 2(b) E2E validated end-to-end against live Supabase + real OpenAI on the preview URL. Backend pytest: 36/36 green (existing) + 9/9 new in test_phase2b_e2e.py. civil_demand workflow produced a complete Spanish demand (encabezamiento + 5 numbered hechos with [E:exxx] markers in every hecho + fundamentos + petitum + otrosíes), 5 evidences all verified=true with quote_excerpt verbatim-substring of source. DOCX export produced a valid 39 KB file with Title/Heading 1-2/Bullets/bold formatting and evidence ids (e001…e005) embedded as smaller grey runs (the [E:] brackets are stripped by design — see docx_exporter._EV_RE). Race-condition test_versioning passes via the insert_draft_atomic RPC (skip-marker proves the RPC exists; collision/gap assertions hold). Sharing E2E full flow OK (24h create → list → public GET ×3 → view_count=3 in DB → revoke → 404; invalid token → 404). Frontend PublicDraftPage loaded without auth, rendered title, watermark 'Galaxy Legal · Demo', banner 'Citas verificadas por Galaxy Legal', side panel with all 5 evidences (page/paragraph/quote/VERIFICADA), no dashboard chrome. Total OpenAI cost across the full suite: $0.0212 (well under the $0.30 sanity cap). Persistent 7-day share token for manual review included below.

seed_data_creation.note: All resources prefixed with 'TEST-2b-'. Share token 47b48943-… is the persistent 7d link for manual review (NOT revoked). The other 4 share tokens were created during sharing flow tests; one was revoked in the suite, the rest remain (24h or 7d).

minor.issue: Mapper omits the 'exported_at' field even though the DB column is updated by POST /api/drafts/{id}/export-docx and the route audit-logs the export. The DB row IS updated correctly (verified by direct admin query), but no API response surfaces it, so the frontend cannot know if a draft was exported. Fix: add `'exported_at': row.get('exported_at')` in services/mappers.py:144 and include it in the public payload too if relevant.

integration_issues.issue: Markers in body render as small inline pills with bare ids (e.g. 'e001') rather than clickable buttons. No element matches `[data-evidence-id]`, `[data-testid^='evidence-marker']`, or `button:has-text('E:')`. The visual presentation is good and the IDs are embedded, but the spec asks for click→scroll→highlight on the side-panel evidence row. Could not verify the click interaction.

test_results_per_test.TEST 1 — civil_demand E2E: PASS (3 sub-assertions). Cost=$0.0212. 5 evidences, 12 [E:xxx] occurrences (5 unique). Encabezamiento + 5 numbered hechos (each with marker) + fundamentos + petitum + otrosíes confirmed.
test_results_per_test.TEST 2 — DOCX export: PASS. signed_url 200, sha256=d69022be3b78431c, 39044 bytes, 43 paragraphs, styles {Title:1, Heading 1:1, Heading 2:5, List Bullet:9, Normal:27}, bold runs present, evidence ids e001..e005 embedded. DB drafts.exported_at updated (mapper omission noted in backend.minor).
test_results_per_test.TEST 3 — Budget guardrail: PASS (logic). Verified via monkeypatch unit test that get_current_usage().over_budget=true with budget=0 and remaining_usd<=0; as_dict() returns the required keys. Restored to 50 confirmed by post-test assertion. NOTE: the live HTTP-402 path was NOT exercised against the running server because monkeypatching settings inside the test process does not affect the supervisord-managed backend process; doing so would require either editing config.py on disk (risky — restore-failure could lock the suite) or adding a runtime override env var. The route logic at /app/backend/routes/runs.py:78-85 is correct (HTTPException 402 with the required message).
test_results_per_test.TEST 4 — Race condition versioning: PASS via tests/test_versioning.py (5 concurrent insert_draft_atomic calls → 5 unique consecutive versions with no gaps). The skip-marker `_rpc_available` proves the RPC exists and is callable; the test calls `admin.rpc('insert_draft_atomic', …)` directly so the RPC path is enforced (NOT max+1 fallback).
test_results_per_test.TEST 5 — Sharing E2E: PASS. Create 201 → list contains token → public GET ×3 returns full payload with watermark, case, draft.content_md (with [E:xxx] markers), evidences[].verified=true → view_count=3 in DB → invalid token 404 → revoke 204 → public GET 404.
test_results_per_test.TEST 6 — Frontend PublicDraftPage: PASS (visual + structural). Persistent URL loads without auth, watermark 'GALAXY LEGAL · DEMO', banner 'Citas verificadas por Galaxy Legal', evidence side panel with 5 entries (E001-E005, page, paragraph, quote, VERIFICADA), markdown body with hechos and inline pill markers. No dashboard chrome. Click-to-scroll on markers could not be verified (see frontend.integration_issues).

action_items: Add `exported_at` to services/mappers.py:draft_to_api so the frontend can surface 'exported' state (currently DB updates but API hides it).

Make the inline `[E:xxx]` markers in PublicDraftPage clickable: emit a `<button data-testid='evidence-marker-<id>' data-evidence-id='<id>'>` that triggers scroll + highlight on the matching evidence row in the side panel. Spec required this interaction (point 6.d).

Optional: align REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env (still pointing to magic-link-preview legacy host) to avoid confusion — Vite ignores it but it is misleading. (Same comment from iteration_1.)
critical_code_review_comments: services/mappers.py:draft_to_api silently drops exported_at — see backend.minor.

routes/runs.py:206-248 has a try/except over the RPC that swallows the exception and silently falls back to the non-transactional max+1 insert. If the RPC is removed or breaks, the fallback masks it. Recommend logging a WARNING when the RPC throws so the fallback path is observable in production.

services/sharing.py:resolve_public_draft uses `.single()` for both the draft and case fetches. If either row is missing or RLS hides it, supabase-py raises rather than returning None. The outer caller treats the share as 'not found' only via the initial empty `.eq('token').limit(1)` check. Edge cases (orphaned share after draft delete) could surface as 500 instead of 404. Wrap the draft/case lookups with a try/except.

services/docx_exporter strips [E:xxx] brackets and renders bare ids in grey. The user-facing spec says markers must remain visible as either superscripts or text — current 'smaller grey run' qualifies as text, but consider keeping the brackets or rendering true superscripts via run.font.subscript = False / superscript = True so the markers are unambiguously distinguishable from prose.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (PublicDraftPage core OK; click-to-scroll on markers unverified)

rca of the issue: Two minor findings, no critical bugs. (1) draft_to_api mapper does not include exported_at — pure mapper omission, fix is one line in services/mappers.py:144 (add `'exported_at': row.get('exported_at')`). Reproduction: POST /api/drafts/{id}/export-docx (returns 200), then GET /api/drafts/{id} → response has no exported_at key, even though the DB row does. (2) Inline evidence markers in PublicDraftPage are non-interactive plain text; they need to be wrapped in clickable buttons with data-testid + data-evidence-id and an onClick that scrolls the corresponding side-panel row into view + applies a transient highlight class. Spec point 6.d explicitly required this.
